summary: Sensient Technologies Corp filed an 8-K to report entry into a $400 million unsecured delayed-draw term loan credit facility with CoBank as administrative agent. The facility is drawn in up to five advances over 15 months and matures five years from closing. Proceeds refinance existing debt and fund general corporate purposes. Interest rates are based on Base Rate or SOFR plus spreads tied to net leverage ratio, with customary covenants and events of default. This is a routine debt refinancing and capital management, not a special-situation event.
